key: Systolic Matrix Solve Using QR Decomposition
title: Systolic Matrix Solve Using QR Decomposition
source_docs: Fixed-Point Designer HDL Support/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Linear System Solvers/Systolic_Matrix_Solve_Using_QR_Decomposition.md
text: Compute value of X in the equation A X = B using QR decomposition, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, {Output datatype} sets Data type of output matrix X; {Number of rows in matrices A and B}, {Number of columns in matrix A}, {Number of columns in matrix B} and {Signal type} sets the complexity of matrices. Values come from the instance.

params.values: Number of columns in matrix B 1 (default) | positive integer-valued scalar

params.values: Data type of output matrix X fixdt(1,18,4) (default) | double | single | fixdt(1,16,0) |
